svg.title: DIA-007A · A wall in six lengths
svg.desc: An engraved plate of one stone wall seen from the front, divided into six lengths, one for each constraint. The first two lengths, the electricity grid and chip supply, are old masonry at full height: the first has a breach with a road running through it, the second is cracked with stones fallen from the top. The next two, product liability and the EU AI Act, are new work: liability is two courses of footing, and the EU AI Act is raised to full height for eight twenty-sevenths of its length and footing for the rest. The fifth length, interpretability, is only pegs and string with a dashed outline where the wall would stand. The sixth, open weights, is bare ground.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 7 · SAFETY RISK AND BINDING CONSTRAINTS
A binding constraint limits what is possible, not merely what is permitted:
a wall, rather than a posted speed limit.
never built to govern, and gone around
sound in design, not yet raised
facts that limit what governance can reach
DIA-007A · Six constraints on AI, drawn as the wall the word implies. No length of it stands whole.
